wirtsLeg.name: Wirt's Leg
wirtsLeg.desc: Recovered from Wirt's remains in the Dark Wood. This bound ingredient is consumed together with the portal Tome when you Transmute at Akara. The Cube is retained.

cowPortalTome.name: Bound Portal Tome
cowPortalTome.desc: A free bound ritual ingredient Received explicitly from Akara after recovering Wirt's Leg. Consumed with the Leg to open one Cow King portal; it is not general scroll stock.

horadricMalus.name: Horadric Malus
horadricMalus.description: Recovered from the cache after clearing the Catacombs. Give this bound quest item to Charsi in the Rogue Encampment.

scrollOfInifuss.name: Scroll of Inifuss
scrollOfInifuss.description: Recovered at the Tree of Inifuss after clearing the Dark Wood. Give it to Akara in the Rogue Encampment; then return to the ruined-village cage to rescue Cain.

malahsPotion.name: Malah’s Potion
malahsPotion.description: Bound quest potion. Use it at frozen Anya in the Crystalline Passage. It cannot restore Life or Mana in combat.

scrollOfResistance.name: Scroll of Resistance
scrollOfResistance.description: Read once for permanent +{{allResist}}% fire, cold, lightning, poison, arcane and physical resistance. Claiming alone grants no resistance.

mephistosSoulstone.name: Mephisto’s Soulstone
mephistosSoulstone.description: A bound quest trophy granted by The Guardian. Consumed together with the Hellforge Hammer when shattering the Soulstone at the Hellforge. It cannot be read or equipped.

khalimsHeart.name: Khalim’s Heart
khalimsHeart.description: Recover it in the Flayer Jungle after clearing the area. Consumed when assembling Khalim’s Will.

khalimsBrain.name: Khalim’s Brain
khalimsBrain.description: Recover it in the Great Marsh after clearing the area. Consumed when assembling Khalim’s Will.

khalimsEye.name: Khalim’s Eye
khalimsEye.description: Recover it in the Kurast Bazaar after clearing the area. Consumed when assembling Khalim’s Will.

khalimsFlail.name: Khalim’s Flail
khalimsFlail.description: Defeat the High Council in Travincal, then recover the Flail explicitly. Consumed when assembling Khalim’s Will.

khalimsWill.name: Khalim’s Will
khalimsWill.description: Assemble from all four components using the retained Horadric Cube. Consumed when breaking the Compelling Orb in Travincal. Claim the quest reward separately.

recipe.ready: Ready to assemble {{item}} wherever you are.
recipe.unavailable: Recover every ingredient and {{tool}}, and complete the earlier quest objectives first. Assembly is portable.
recipe.owned: {{item}} assembled. Claim the quest reward separately in Quests.
recipe.consumed: {{item}} has been used at its destination. Its ingredients remain recorded as used.

jadeFigurine.name: Jade Figurine
jadeFigurine.description: Recover the figurine in the Spider Forest, then give it to Deckard Cain in Kurast Docks in exchange for the Golden Bird.

goldenBird.name: Golden Bird
goldenBird.description: Cain exchanged this bird for the Jade Figurine. Give it to Alkor in Kurast Docks.

potionOfLife.name: Potion of Life
potionOfLife.description: Read once for +{{maxLife}} permanent maximum Life. Current Life and XP do not change.

recovery.ready: Recover this previously claimed quest reward. This does not grant XP.

gidbinn.name: The Gidbinn
gidbinn.description: Recover this sacred blade in the Flayer Jungle, then give it to Ormus in Kurast Docks.

lam_esens_tome.name: Lam Esen’s Tome
lam_esens_tome.description: Recover this ancient tome in the Kurast Bazaar, then give it to Alkor in Kurast Docks.

questItems.bound: Bound to this character. Does not use backpack or stash space.

horadricCube.name: Horadric Cube
horadricCube.description: Retained tool for Horadric transmutation. Bound to this character.

bookOfSkill.name: Book of Skill
bookOfSkill.description: Read once to gain {{skillPoints}} skill point.

staffOfKings.name: Staff of Kings
staffOfKings.description: Bound component for the Horadric Staff. Consumed during assembly.

viperAmulet.name: Viper Amulet
viperAmulet.description: Bound component for the Horadric Staff. Consumed during assembly.

horadricStaff.name: Horadric Staff
horadricStaff.description: Insert this bound Staff into the orifice in Tal Rasha’s Tomb.

assembly.ready: Combine the shaft and amulet in the Cube. The Cube is retained.
assembly.unavailable: Recover the Cube, Staff of Kings and Viper Amulet before assembling.
assembly.owned: Horadric Staff assembled. Claim the quest reward separately in Quests.
assembly.consumed: The Staff was inserted into the tomb. Its components remain recorded as used.
assembly.claimed: Horadric Staff assembled. Quest reward claimed.

hellforgeHammer.name: Hellforge Hammer
hellforgeHammer.desc: Defeat Hephasto in the River of Flame while tracking Hell’s Forge, then recover this bound hammer. Shattering the Soulstone consumes both this hammer and Mephisto’s Soulstone. Claim the quest reward separately.

sunCultTome.name: Sun-Cult Tome
sunCultTome.description: An ancient manuscript recovered in the Lost City. It remains with you after completion. Claim the XP and skill point separately in Quests.

horazonLockbox.name: Horazon's Lockbox
horazonLockbox.description: A memento recovered in the Arcane Sanctuary on Normal. It stays with you after completion; claim its XP and Manald Heal reward separately in Quests.

elzixStrongbox.name: Elzix's Strongbox
elzixStrongbox.description: A memento recovered in the Far Oasis on Normal. It stays with you after completion; claim its XP and The Eye of Etlich reward separately in Quests.

nihlathakRelic.name: Nihlathak’s Relic
nihlathakRelic.description: Recovered in Crystalline Passage after defeating Nihlathak. This keepsake remains with you; claim XP and Mara's Kaleidoscope separately in Quests.

alkor.name: Venom Gland
alkor.desc: Recover three distinct glands in the Spider Forest on Normal. Claim in your journal exchanges all three for XP and five unallocated stat points.

jade.name: Jade Trinket
jade.desc: Recover three distinct trinkets in Kurast Bazaar on Normal. Give all three to Meshif, then Claim XP and rune shards separately.

jamella.name: Forge Ember
jamella.desc: Recover five distinct embers in the River of Flame on Normal. Claim in your journal exchanges all five for XP and one perfect gem.

malah.name: Frost Lichen
malah.desc: Recover five distinct lichens in the Ancients' Way on Normal. Claim exchanges all five for XP and +10 effective Vitality after the ordinary soft cap, without restoring Life.

gheed.name: Gheed's Salvage Lot
gheed.desc: A marked salvage lot in the Cold Plains. Collect all five and exchange them together when you Claim in Quests. Recovering a lot grants no immediate reward.

counted.bound: Bound quest ingredients. Exchange the full set; no Read, sale or crafting action.

crafting.title: Crafting & sockets

runewordGuide.bonusNote: Base stats and ordinary rune effects also apply. Preview an insertion to see the full item.
runewordGuide.title: Runeword recipes
runewordGuide.level: Equip level: {{level}}. The base's level and attribute requirements also apply.
runewordGuide.ingredients: Runes required for the full recipe
runewordGuide.instructions: This guide does not insert or spend anything. Select your equipment and socket material below, then preview each insertion. Existing inserts must follow the same order; a gem or a different rune order prevents a runeword.

crafting.progression: Rune fusion uses your highest unlocked act and selected difficulty: Act I–V caps are rune 8 / 15 / 19 / 21 / 33. Normal and Nightmare stop at Um (22). With Act V unlocked and Hell selected, all 32 upgrades through Zod (33) are available; each turns three identical runes into one of the next rune. Gem fusion can exceed the gem drop cap.

rules.rune-fusion: Exchange three identical runes for the next rune. The output must be unlocked.
rules.gem-fusion: Exchange three identical subperfect gems and one gem-shard for the next quality.
rules.gem-dismantle: Destroy one gem to obtain gem-shards based on its quality.
rules.socket-insert: Select one unequipped backpack weapon or armor with an empty socket. Inserts fill the next socket in order. Exact rune order, base, slot and capacity determine a runeword; other combinations retain their plain socket effects.
rules.socket-armor: Select one normal chest item in your backpack with empty contents. Its socket capacity is rolled from 1 to the base maximum.
rules.socket-clear: Select one backpack weapon or armor with inserted materials. Clearing retains the item and socket capacity, and destroys every insert without a refund.
rules.caster-amulet: Select one identified magic amulet in your backpack with empty contents. It becomes rare with Energy +5, Mana +20 and one legal prefix and suffix.
rules.salvage: Select unequipped backpack or stash gear. Equipped, quest-bound and reserved Iron Golem items cannot be salvaged. Discarding items is a separate action and grants no materials.
rules.recover-v18: Select one preserved v18 item. Recovery places the same item in your backpack as normal gear with empty contents and refunds only its explicitly recorded runes. Older preserved gear remains inspect-only.

crafting.noWord: No completed runeword. Plain socket effects apply.
crafting.destroyGear: Selected equipment and all inserted materials will be permanently destroyed. Inserts are not refunded.
crafting.destroyInserts: Every inserted material and the completed runeword will be permanently removed. No inserts are refunded.
crafting.destroyGem: The selected gem will be permanently destroyed.
crafting.recoverNotice: The preserved runeword is removed. The same item ID, base, rolls, capacity and personalization are retained. Only the listed runes are refunded.

error.idle: Finish or leave the current battle before crafting.

error.capacity: Make room in your backpack for the recovered item.

error.unknown: Check your inventory and saved state before retrying.
error.rollback: Restoration could not be verified. Reload or import a verified backup before continuing.

crafting.recoveryRequired: Crafting is paused while the save is unavailable. If restoration failed, reload or import a verified backup before continuing.

lootFilter.title: Loot Filter
lootFilter.immediate: Changes apply immediately. You can prepare rules while the filter is disabled.
lootFilter.scope: Applies to new combat loot only. Quest rewards, purchased items, existing inventory and equipped gear are unaffected.
lootFilter.levelHelp: 0 applies to all item levels. Otherwise, rules apply to items at or below this level; higher-level items are kept.
lootFilter.levelError: Enter a whole number from 0 to 9,007,199,254,740,991. The previous valid limit remains active.
lootFilter.protected: Runewords, charms, gear with inserted runes or gems, and personalized gear are always kept.
lootFilter.salvageHelp: Auto-salvage grants crafting scrap. Auto-discard gives no materials. These actions permanently consume the new drop and do not award gold.
